item: {"addr": "0x14159b720", "comment": "[re]\nAddressLib ID 109334\nA load's body decompressor (file = BGSSaveLoadFile). Already-decoded flag +0xBCA set: true. Seeks to bodyOffset (+0xBC4, the end of header + screenshot). compressionType (+0xBC8, from the header): 0 = true at once, the body is read as it lies, NO length fields; 1 = zlib, 2 = LZ4: reads u32 uncompressedLen (+0xBC0) and u32 compressedLen, decodes into a scrap buffer, must equal uncompressedLen, then replaces the file buffer's body with the decoded bytes and sets +0xBCA. Any other type: false. So a save written with type 0 and a raw body loads (SkyrimCoop save sync writes those)."}

{"addr": "0x14159B530", "comment": "The save side of 109334 (called from Save_Impl 35727 when writing at once; the save thread's request otherwise). uncompressedLen (+0xBC0) = file size - bodyOffset (+0xBC4). compressionType (+0xBC8, copied from uiCompression:SaveGame by Save_Impl) 1 = zlib (109347), 2 = LZ4 (109346): writes u32 uncompressedLen, u32 compressedLen, the compressed body at bodyOffset and truncates. Type 0: returns, body left raw with no length fields."}

{"addr": "0x14061E9E0", "comment": "AddressLib ID 35672. Writes a save's header: the magic TESV_SAVEGAME, then (through a BGSSaveGameBuffer, u32 size first) version, save number, player name, level, location, game date, race editor id, sex u16, current/level-up exp, FILETIME, screenshot width/height and u16 compressionType (file+0xBC8); then the screenshot. Returns the bytes written = the body's offset (Save_Impl stores it at file+0xBC4)."}

{"addr": "0x14061EE40", "comment": "AddressLib ID 35673. Reads a save's header: checks the magic TESV_SAVEGAME, parses the header into the BGSSaveLoadFileEntry (a2), sets file+0xBC8 = its compressionType (entry+0x66) and, when that is 0, file+0xBCA = 1 (body needs no decode; see 109334). Called by the load (442580), the save list and PopulateFileEntryData."}
{"addr": "0x1406148F0", "comment": "AddressLib ID 35542. Returns the entry's compressionType (u16 at +0x66): 0 none, 1 zlib, 2 LZ4."}
{"addr": "0x140627f3a", "comment": "BGSSaveLoadFile__DecompressBody (109334): type 0 passes with the body as it lies"}
{"addr": "0x140622de3", "comment": "device 2: body compressed and the file written here, on this thread; devices 3/4/5 leave both to a SaveOperationRequest on the save thread (above)"}

{"addr": "0x14062A300", "comment": "Runs one queued save thread request by its id (+0xC). 0x40000001 = bgs::saveload::SaveOperationRequest (Save_Impl 35727 queues it for devices 3/4/5 through 35791): file = request+0x148; re-reads the header (35675), BGSSaveLoadFile__CompressBody, then BSWin32SaveDataSystemUtility vfunc 0x68 writes the file (path info request+0x130). The same three calls run inline in Save_Impl for device 2. So a save's .ess reaches disk here, off the main thread, after Save_Impl returned; SKSE's .skse was already written inside Save_Impl (Thread::SaveGame_HookTarget)."}

{"addr": "0x14062a160", "comment": "[re]\nAddressLib ID 35791\nQueues a request on the save thread (thread = manager+0x2F8) and signals it; when the queue is full on the save thread itself, runs it at once (BGSSaveLoadManager__Thread__RunRequest). Save_Impl queues its SaveOperationRequest (0x40000001) here."}

{"addr": "0x14159c580", "comment": "AddressLib ID 109353. BSWin32SaveDataSystemUtility vfunc 0x68: writes a save's file, here and now. (utility rcx, BGSSaveLoadFile** file rdx, a3 r8; r9 and the stack unused, checked in the disassembly.) Opens the path kept in the file (file+0x64), writes the file's whole buffer (vfunc 0xA0 data, vfunc 0x50 size) through sub_140EC0600, closes it, then hands a result record with the file to the utility's list (utility+8): the callers free the file right after. Called by Save_Impl 35727 (device 2, inline) and by BGSSaveLoadManager__Thread__RunRequest 35794 (devices 3/4/5, save thread), each after BGSSaveLoadFile__CompressBody. So when this returns, the .ess is on disk: SkyrimCoop hooks it for SaveWrittenEvent (the save's name: file+0xBB0, read before the call)."}

{"addr": "0x14159D450", "comment": "BSTEventSource::SendEvent of the save data utility's source (utility+8): calls each sink's ProcessEvent now, on the calling thread. WriteSaveFile (109353) sends its result record through it; the sink that matters is BGSSaveLoadManager::ProcessEvent (35773), which puts the written .tmp in place."}

{"addr": "0x140626240", "comment": "[re]\nAddressLib ID 35773\nThe save manager's sink for the save data utility's events (sent by 109353 through sub_14159D450, on the writing thread). Event type 1 with status 0 = a save's file was written: the file was written as <name>.ess.tmp (35724 asks PrepareFileSavePath 109357 for a tmp path); here the older <name>.ess goes to .bak (iSaveGameBackupCount of them, 0x1420B5548), rename(tmp, <name>.ess), then the catalogue and the character's save entry (last quicksave, counts) are updated. So when WriteSaveFile returns, the final .ess exists under the save's name (file+0xBB0)."}

{"addr": "0x140622390", "comment": "[re]\nAddressLib ID 35724\nMakes the BGSSaveLoadFile a save is written through (out a2): its path from PrepareFileSavePath (109357) with tmp = a4 (Save_Impl passes 1: <name>.ess.tmp), its name (a3) at file+0xAB0 region / +0xBB0, opened for writing (vfunc 0x40). Quicksaves and autosaves also get a slot tag (QS/AS + character id)."}
